As digital marketplaces continue to prioritize frictionless user experiences, security experts and consumers alike are examining the balance between payment ease and robust fraud prevention measures.

content: Technology vendors are increasingly promoting artificial intelligence solutions adapted for financial institutions, often by claiming models are trained on banking data or wrapped in a banking interface. The post Texas-Based McKesson Confirms Cloud Breach, Allegedly Exposing 248,000,000 Patient Records appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Texas-based healthcare company McKesson has confirmed a cybersecurity breach impacting its cloud systems and data units. An extortion group claims to have stolen a massive volume of patient records and is demanding a multi-million-dollar ransom. McKesson is currently investigating the incident to assess the scope of the unauthorized data access and secure its networks.
